share.heading: Share to the community
share.description: Publish your script to the community repository so it appears in the Community tab. Here's how:
share.signIn: Sign in to GitHub. A free account is enough, and the app never sees your credentials.
share.genericStart: Open a GitHub issue to see the contribution template.
share.genericDetails: Fill in the details and add a 16:9 preview image if you have one.
share.genericSubmit: Submit the issue. A maintainer will review it and add it to the registry.
share.genericFinish: After merging, the script appears in Community for everyone.
share.scriptStart: Open a GitHub issue. Your script is copied to the clipboard.
share.scriptPaste: Paste with Cmd/Ctrl+V to fill in the submission.
share.scriptPreview: Add a 16:9 preview image if you have one, then submit the issue.
share.scriptFinish: A maintainer will review it. After merging, it appears in Community.
share.copied: Copied to clipboard. Paste with Cmd/Ctrl+V in the GitHub tab and submit the issue.
